title: Lusitano Hall and playing with white bands as the only Black boy
summary: Photos of the Italian Hall and the Lusitano Hall on Elysian Fields; he sat in with Fischer's and Schilling's white bands though not a regular member.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Here's a picture. I took those pictures the other day after you left, about the next day.
And you told us about this other place on Elysian Field.
Elysian Field in Dolphin. That's it, yeah. What went on there? That's the dance up here.
Do you remember any name for that hall?
Who's band did you play with there?
It was Fishers Band and they had Schillings Band, too.
Oh, yeah. They were both white bands?
White bands, yeah. Yeah, they were white bands.
Were there any colored persons in other than, I mean, yourself? I mean, was there any other colored?
Yeah. In other words, now don't get me wrong. I wasn't a member of the band.
You see? Well, quite nice. They were men and I was boy. But I'd go there and play with them. You see, because they all knowed me. Was that done fairly often in those days? I mean... Yes, very often.
